class.name: BoneClothCollisionPlane3D
class.brief_description: An infinite plane collision that interacts with [BoneClothSimulator3D].
class.description: An infinite plane collision that interacts with [BoneClothSimulator3D]. It is an infinite size XZ plane, and the +Y direction is treated as normal. The joints stay on the +Y side, at their radius from the plane, and a joint that went through it in one step comes back.
